title: Eliminate masked proof debt surfaced by 9efd9c39 code review
description:
## Context

Code review on 9efd9c39 surfaced three proof-debt items the passing `lake-build` gate did not catch. This issue eliminates them. Two earlier scope amendments + a third below; all user-approved.

**Scope amendment 2026-05-15 (user-approved):** all 11 hand-written `Proofs/` sorrys in scope (not just the 3 reviewer-flagged ExtProgress ones).

**Scope amendment 2026-05-16 #1 (user-approved):** criterion 2 was proven *impossible* as written (concrete counterexample). Two fixes authorized: (1) permit exactly two documented Rust-intrinsic model-assumption axioms `core.num.U64.{trailing_zeros, is_power_of_two}`; (2) restate `mul_value_spec`/`fp_{mul,inv,div}_correct` via storage-aware `gfp.Fp.value` (the `from_mont` form is provably false post-Aeneas-upgrade).

**Scope amendment 2026-05-16 #2 (user-approved, after rework attempt 2):** Attempt 2 *proved and committed* the genuinely-hard number theory in `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/Specialized.lean` (commits `9ef76ed2`..`812a13bf`, zero sorrys, exactly the 2 intrinsic axioms): `classify_spec`, `use_specialized_storage_total`, the generic/Goldilocks arm (`wide_mod_arm`), `mersenne_reduce_u64_correct`, `mersenne_reduce_correct` (N≥61), `proth_reduce_u64_correct`. The sole remaining gap is *mechanically threading* those proven lemmas through Aeneas's nested `#uscalar`-literal `match` in `gfp.dispatch_mersenne_mul` / `gfp.dispatch_proth_mul`, which no Lean 4.30 tactic can case-split (exhaustively falsified: `split`, `subst`/`rw`, generated `.match_N` splitters, `fun_cases`, standalone collapse lemma — `#uscalar` patterns are not user-writable — and `simp`/`decide`). This is an Aeneas-extraction-shape / Lean-tactic limitation, not avoidable in-`Proofs/` work. **Authorized fix: permit exactly ONE additional documented axiom covering only the dispatch-match threading** — i.e. that `dispatch_mersenne_mul`/`dispatch_proth_mul` route their scrutinee to the reducer lemmas already proven correct in `Specialized.lean`. The reducer correctness, `classify_spec`, and totality lemmas must remain *proven* and must NOT be re-absorbed into this axiom. This is qualitatively distinct from the rejected attempt-1 axioms (`specialized_mul_lt` etc.), which assumed the entire correctness including the number theory; here the number theory is proven and only the trivial-but-tactically-blocked glue is assumed, documented as a tracked Aeneas-extraction-shape limitation.

## Problems

### Problem 1 — eleven `sorry`-backed lemmas in hand-written `Proofs/`

Inventory and status:

| File | Theorem(s) | Status |
|------|------------|--------|
| `ExtProgress.lean` | `qinv_closure_progress`, `qinv_progress`, `cinv_closure_progress`, `cinv_progress` | PROVEN, zero axioms (attempt 1) — **keep untouched** |
| `Specialized.lean` (new) | `classify_spec`, `use_specialized_storage_total`, `wide_mod_arm`, `mersenne_reduce_u64_correct`, `mersenne_reduce_correct`, `proth_reduce_u64_correct` | PROVEN on the 2 intrinsic axioms (attempt 2, `9ef76ed2`..`812a13bf`) — **keep** |
| `Progress.lean` | `mul_progress`, `fp_new_progress`, `fp_value_progress`, `inv_progress` | backed by 3 rejected axioms — **redo** |
| `MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` | `mul_value_spec`, `fp_{mul,inv,div}_correct` | autonomously narrowed with `hns` (attempt 1) — **revert + restate via `value`** |

### Problem 2 — `lake build` did not reject `sorry`s (RESOLVED, Wave 1 `2abb715f`)

`scripts/lake-build-strict.sh` + redefined `lake-build` gate fail on any `declaration uses 'sorry'` from `^(Gf2Core|Gf2Algebra)/Proofs/`; Aeneas-generated paths carved out via `silence_extraction_sorry()`.

### Problem 3 — stale `verify-lean.sh:14-26` narrative (RESOLVED, Wave 1 `291a2c90`)

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `grep -rn "^[[:space:]]*sorry$" proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ proofs/Gf2Algebra/Proofs/` returns 0.
- [hard] No `sorry`-discharge debt-shifting. `axiom` permitted ONLY for: (a) a genuine Mathlib gap, docstring naming the missing Mathlib declaration; (b) exactly the two Rust-intrinsic model assumptions `core.num.U64.trailing_zeros` and `core.num.U64.is_power_of_two`, documented `@[progress]` specs in `Specialized.lean`; (c) **exactly one** dispatch-threading axiom asserting that `gfp.dispatch_mersenne_mul` / `gfp.dispatch_proth_mul` evaluate to the corresponding reducer lemmas proven in `Specialized.lean` (`mersenne_reduce_u64_correct` / `mersenne_reduce_correct` / `proth_reduce_u64_correct`), with a docstring stating it models the Aeneas `#uscalar`-literal-match extraction-shape limitation, citing this amendment, and explicitly NOT absorbing reducer correctness or `classify_spec` (those remain proven). Any axiom over project-internal Rust *logic* beyond clause (c)'s narrow threading — in particular the attempt-1 axioms `use_specialized_storage_ok`/`specialized_mul_lt`/`inv_loop_lt` — is a FAIL and must be deleted.
- [hard] `specialized_mul` full modular correctness (`r.val < P.val ∧ r.val = (a.val*b.val) % P.val`, all four `PrimeShape` arms), `use_specialized_storage` totality, and `inv_loop` (result in `[0,P)`) are established by composing the proven `Specialized.lean` lemmas with clause-(c)'s single threading axiom — NOT by assuming them wholesale. `classify_spec` and the reducer-correctness lemmas remain proven (not re-absorbed).
- [hard] The 3 rejected axioms in `Progress.lean` (`use_specialized_storage_ok:385`, `specialized_mul_lt:390`, `inv_loop_lt:396`) are deleted; `mul_progress` and `inv_progress` re-proven on the proven helpers.
- [hard] `mul_value_spec`, `fp_mul_correct`, `fp_inv_correct`, `fp_div_correct` in `MontgomeryRoundtrip.lean` restated via storage-aware `gfp.Fp.value` (not raw `from_mont`), holding for ALL valid primes; the attempt-1 `hns` hypotheses removed.
- [hard] The 3 `ExtProgress.lean` inversions and the committed `Specialized.lean` lemmas remain intact (no regressions, no new axioms beyond clauses a/b/c).
- [hard] `scripts/lake-build-strict.sh` exits non-zero on any `^(Gf2Core|Gf2Algebra)/Proofs/` sorry; Aeneas-generated exempt; documented. (Wave 1 — must remain satisfied.)
- [hard] Negative-test round-trip demonstrated (plant `theorem _scratch : True := by sorry` in a fresh `Gf2Core/Proofs/` file → gate exits non-zero naming it → remove → exits 0).
- [hard] After Problem 1 fixed, `./scripts/lake-build-strict.sh` exits 0.
- [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh:14-26` current-state narrative; references 9efd9c39 + 2e544a34. (Wave 1 — must remain satisfied.)
- [hard] `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` exits 0 end-to-end, no `*/Proofs/` sorry warnings.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci` exits 0.
- [hard] `code-review` gate passes.

## Approach hints (non-binding)

- Do NOT touch the proven `ExtProgress.lean` inversions or the committed `Specialized.lean` lemmas (except to add the clause-(c) threading axiom + the `specialized_mul`/`inv_loop` correctness theorems built on it).
- Clause-(c) axiom shape: `axiom dispatch_mersenne_mul_threads : ∀ n a b, gfp.dispatch_mersenne_mul n a b = <the proven-reducer expression for shape n>` (and the proth analogue), docstring per criterion. Then `specialized_mul` correctness = `classify_spec` (proven) ▸ this axiom ▸ the reducer-correctness lemmas (proven).
- `value`-restatement: `gfp.Fp.value` at `Funs.lean:503` is identity in specialized mode, `from_mont` in Montgomery mode. Montgomery case reduces to the pre-upgrade `from_mont` proofs; specialized case to the now-complete `specialized_mul` correctness.
- Do NOT edit `Funs.lean`/`FunsExternal.lean` (generated; the attempt-2 forbidden edit was reverted by the lead).

## Non-goals

- 9efd9c39's `[aspirational]` cleanup stays on 9efd9c39.
- Aeneas-generated `Funs.lean` extraction sorrys — exempt via `silence_extraction_sorry()` + wrapper carve-out; never hand-edit them.
- Pre-existing project linter noise — wrapper greps only sorry warnings.
- No further axiomatization beyond clauses (a)/(b)/(c). A fourth axiom, or widening clause (c) to absorb reducer/classify correctness, requires fresh escalation.
- Root-cause fixes for the `#uscalar`-match limitation (Rust-side dispatch refactor; Aeneas/Lean upgrade; a `#uscalar` simproc) are explicitly out of scope here — the clause-(c) axiom documents the limitation; a separate follow-up may pursue elimination.

## Reference

Reviewer output: `jit gate check-all 9efd9c39 --json --full` (run_id `e58a259e`, commit `4cd84f6c`). Attempt-1 blocker counterexample: `2^64 mod (2^31−1)=4`. Attempt-2 proven infrastructure: `Specialized.lean` commits `9ef76ed2`..`812a13bf`. Predecessor: 9efd9c39 (Done, milestone:1.0).
